Rate Quotation and Evaluation 2.1 The bidder shall quote rates separately against each destination and the corresponding vehicle catego ry specified. 2.2 The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all taxes, duties, levies and charges, including GST(R CM/FCM), freight, toll tax, fuel charges, driver charges, loading/unloading charges, road taxes and all other incidental expenses applicable for transportation of the goods. No additional pay ment whatsoever shall be admissible over and above the accepted quoted rates. 2.3 The bidder shall clearly indicate the applicable GST and other statutory tax components. 2.4 Evaluation of financial bids shall be undertaken on a station-wise/item-wise basis. 2.5 The quoted rates shall remain valid for a period of 30 days from the date of award of contract. Deployment of Vehicles 3.1 The successful bidder shall provide the specified vehicle at GMSD, Karnal, strictly on the date and time communicated through the email/official communication. 3.3 The vehicle provided shall strictly conform to the required size and type, i.e. closed-body/open-body, a s specified against the respective destination. Any vehicle not conforming to the prescribed specifications may be rejected by GMSD without any liability for payment. 3.4 The vehicle shall be roadworthy, clean, properly maintained and suitable for transportation of medical goods/medical stores. 3.5 The successful bidder shall deploy only vehicles having valid Registration Certificate, Fitness Certificat e, Insurance, Pollution under Control Certificate and applicable permits, as required under the Motor Vehicl es Act and other applicable laws. The driver shall possess a valid driving license and other requisite author izations. 3.6 Copies of the relevant vehicle documents and driver's particulars shall be furnished to GMSD before de ployment of the vehicle. 3.7 The transporter shall ensure the availability of the vehicle and the driver/representative remains availa ble during loading and shall obtain the necessary dispatch documents. 4. Loading and Transportation 4.1 The transporter shall report at GMSD, Karnal, at the designated loading point and shall ensure that the vehicle is positioned appropriately for loading. 4.2 Loading and unloading arrangements shall be as specified in the bid document. No addition al charges on account of labour, handling or incidental expenses shall be payable beyond the accepted rates. 4.3 The transporter shall ensure safe transportation of the medical goods/medical stores and take all neces

sary precautions to prevent damage, loss, theft, contamination, exposure to adverse weather conditions or deterioration during transit. 4.4 The medical goods shall be transported in the same vehicle in which they were loaded at GMSD, Karna l. Trans-shipment or shifting of goods to another vehicle shall not be permitted without prior written appro val of the competent authority of GMSD. 4.5 The transporter shall not unload or deliver the goods at any place other than the designated consignee 's address without prior written permission from GMSD. 4.6 The consignments in transit will be handed over to the transporter duly insured. 4.7 In case of any loss due to any reason during transit the transporter will be liable to lodge F.I.R in the ne arest Police Station from the location where the incident took place and take up the matter with Insurance Company as per laid down procedure and will follow up till the settlement of claim under intimation to this office. In case, the claim is not passed for actual cost of store, the transporter will be liable to pay/remit the difference of amount of claim and actual cost of loss. 5. Delivery of Goods 5.1 The transporter shall deliver the entire consignment at the designated consignee's premises on a door- delivery basis within the delivery schedule specified in the email or communicated through any other mod e. 5.2 The transporter shall ensure that the goods are delivered in good condition and obtain proper acknowl edgement from the consignee/authorized representative, bearing signature, date, stamp and other relevant particulars. 5.3 The transporter shall submit the duly acknowledged delivery receipt along with the invoice and other r elevant documents to GMSD, Karnal, within 10 days of delivery. 6. Penalty and Risk Purchase 6.1 In case the successful bidder fails to provide the specified vehicle within the stipulated period without a valid justification, GMSD reserves the right to cancel the work order and arrange transportation through another agency and the firm shall be liable for debarment/blacklisting in accordance with the applicable G overnment of India guidelines and shall also be reported to GeM through the prescribed Incident Reporting mechanism for taking appropriate action at their end, as per the applicable GeM terms and conditions.. 6.2 In case of delay in delivery attributable to the transporter, penalty will be imposed at the rate of 0.5% of the value of the delayed transportation assignment per day, subject to a maximum of 5% of the value of the delayed assignment. 7. Payment Terms 7.1 Payment shall be released only after satisfactory completion of the transportation assignment and rece ipt of the consignment by the consignee. 7.2 The transporter shall submit the invoice along with the duly acknowledged delivery receipt and other r equisite documents. 7.3 Applicable statutory deductions, including TDS, shall be made at source as per prevailing rules. 8. General Conditions 8.1 In case of any dispute arising out of the contract, the same shall be dealt with in accordance with the a pplicable laws and contractual dispute-resolution provisions. The courts having competent jurisdiction at K arnal shall have jurisdiction, subject to applicable law. 8.2 All matters not specifically covered herein shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and other relevant Government instructions. Stamp and Signature of the Bidder/Authorized Signatory .
